# Keel

> Host-owned routing and swappable frontend packs. The server owns URLs, page ids, and payload types. Packs implement ids — never paths.

Keel is a protocol plus Kotlin/JS libraries. Format `keel/1`. First host adapter is Ktor; first pack adapter is Svelte 5. Maven: `dev.kolektiv.keel:core`, `dev.kolektiv.keel:ktor`. npm: `@kolektiv/keel`, `@kolektiv/keel-svelte`, `@kolektiv/keel-pack`.

Live contract: `GET /__keel/schema` on any Keel host. Scaffold a pack with `keel-scaffold <origin> <dir>`.

Docs: https://keel.mey.cat/  (GitHub Pages; local `pnpm dev` is http://127.0.0.1:8080/)

## Docs

- [Server Installation](https://keel.mey.cat/docs/getting-started/server/): Maven — one repo (`maven-releases` or `maven-snapshots`), `dev.kolektiv.keel:core`
- [Client Setup](https://keel.mey.cat/docs/getting-started/client/): npm — one registry (`npm-releases` or `npm-snapshots`), `@kolektiv/keel*`
- [Host (Ktor)](https://keel.mey.cat/docs/getting-started/host/): stand up a Keel host
- [Pack (Svelte)](https://keel.mey.cat/docs/getting-started/pack/): keel-scaffold or keelPack in Vite
- [Wire protocol](https://keel.mey.cat/docs/implementing/protocol/): seed JSON, headers, status codes, path grammar, CSRF, `/__keel/schema`
- [Host adapter](https://keel.mey.cat/docs/implementing/host-adapter/): what a backend must implement
- [Pack adapter](https://keel.mey.cat/docs/implementing/pack-adapter/): PageModule, .feb, RouterAdapter
- [Typegen](https://keel.mey.cat/docs/implementing/typegen/): `.ts`, `.d.ts`, JSON contract
- [Routing](https://keel.mey.cat/docs/core-concepts/routing/)
- [Actions](https://keel.mey.cat/docs/core-concepts/actions/)
- [Packs](https://keel.mey.cat/docs/core-concepts/packs/)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/kolektivdev/keel/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how to work in this repository

## Optional

- [Harbor sample](https://github.com/kolektivdev/keel/tree/main/samples/harbor): `./gradlew :samples:harbor:run` → http://127.0.0.1:8090
- [Partial reloads](https://keel.mey.cat/docs/advanced/partials/)

## Skills

- [keel-host](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kolektivdev/keel/main/skills/keel-host/SKILL.md): implement a Keel server
- [keel-pack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kolektivdev/keel/main/skills/keel-pack/SKILL.md): author a frontend pack
- [keel-scaffold](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kolektivdev/keel/main/skills/keel-scaffold/SKILL.md): scaffold a pack from `/__keel/schema`

Install: `npx skills add kolektivdev/keel`. Or copy `skills/*` into `.claude/skills/`, `.grok/skills/`, or `.agents/skills/`. See `skills/README.md`.
